items.title: ATP reports 49% increase in partnership revenue as sponsorship portfolio expands
items.summary: The ATP says its central partnership revenue rose 49% in 2026 and passed $100M for the first time, more than three times its 2022 level. New deals with Julius Baer, EQT and K-Swiss plus bigger spending from existing sponsors drove the jump, according to Reuters. Chief business officer Daniele Sano said more than 70% of partnership revenue is paid to tournaments for the on-site rights and activation they provide.
items.what_it_means: Centrally sold tour sponsorship is growing fast, and most of the money flows to the events that deliver activation on site.

items.title: NFL Viewership Climbs As ESPN, Amazon Deliver Double-Digit Gains
items.summary: Through Week 9 the NFL is averaging 18.3 million viewers a game, its second-highest mark on record at this point of a season and up 2% on 2025. The weekday packages are doing the lifting: ESPN's Monday Night Football is averaging 19 million, up 24%, and Amazon's Thursday Night Football 17.2 million, up 13%. The league holds the top 49 shows of the current US television season.
items.what_it_means: Weekday streaming and cable windows are now growing the NFL audience faster than its traditional Sunday slots.

items.title: Premier League clubs struggle to attract buyers amid growing sell-off
items.summary: Citing Miguel Delaney of The Independent, SBJ reports that at least eight Premier League clubs, over a third of the league, are officially or unofficially for sale, but there are very few buyers. Sources describe stagnation at the top end, with only fractional or minority deals getting done where they represent real value. Most clubs no longer have growing revenues, and the English game is seen as having topped out, which could show in the next broadcast rights cycle.
items.what_it_means: Investors are cooling on Premier League clubs because revenue growth has stalled, putting pressure on clubs to find income beyond broadcast.

items.title: LOVB Houston sees record ticket sales, growing sponsorship interest ahead of third season
items.summary: LOVB Houston, one of the professional women's volleyball league's original six teams, says ticket revenue has already passed last season's total and its home opener is trending toward a sellout. Chief business officer Lisa Walker expects the team to set league records for corporate partnership revenue by year's end. The club moved home games to the Berry Center for free parking, central access and a consistent fan experience.
items.what_it_means: A third-season women's team is growing tickets and sponsorship together by making the game-day experience easier to attend.

items.title: Report: Skydance to review Europe Olympics rights amid cost-cutting efforts
items.summary: Citing Variety, SBJ reports Skydance will look closely at its financial commitments to sporting events, including the Eurosport Olympic rights across 49 European territories for 2026-32 that it inherited from Warner Bros. Discovery and shares with the EBU. Insiders say cost savings from the Paramount acquisition could approach $3B. The company also plans a big push in early 2027 to bundle HBO Max and Paramount+.
items.what_it_means: Even marquee rights are being reassessed when a media owner's priority shifts to cutting costs and building a streaming bundle.

items.title: PGA Tour sponsorship revenue rises 14% past $1B
items.summary: The PGA Tour says sponsorship revenue rose 14% this year to more than $1B, led by Rolex alongside AWS, Raymond James and AbbVie, according to Bloomberg. Chief commercial officer Dhruv Prasad said the market appears to be validating the Tour's new direction. Sponsors are signed for almost every event in its new Championship Series, with talks under way for Challenger Series tournaments.
items.what_it_means: Sponsors are backing the PGA Tour's restructured schedule, pushing its partnership revenue past $1B.

items.title: Royals to lean on Elevate for new ballpark fan experience and sales consultation
items.summary: The Kansas City Royals have hired Elevate as exclusive sales agent for premium seating and corporate sponsorship at their proposed $1.9B ballpark, which is due in 2030. Elevate will also provide strategy, research, creative and executive search. The 34,000-seat park sits within a roughly 100-acre mixed-use development with Hallmark, a $3B project in total, with Delaware North on food and beverage and Legends as owners' rep.
items.what_it_means: New ballparks are being sold as year-round mixed-use districts, with premium and sponsorship planned years before opening.

items.title: As combat sports grows in popularity, Apple adds UFC section for Apple Sports app
items.summary: Apple has added a UFC section to its Apple Sports iPhone app, starting with UFC 334 at Madison Square Garden. Fans who pick UFC get the full fight card, live round-by-round scoring, fighter records and a silhouette showing where strikes land, with lock-screen widgets and Apple Watch updates. The app, launched in 2024, now comes pre-loaded on new iPhones.
items.what_it_means: Platform owners are building sport-specific second-screen features to hold fan attention during live events.

items.title: Sodexo Live a bright spot during parent company's tough 2026
items.summary: Sodexo Live's North American revenue rose 7.3% to $1.76B in 2026, helped by a nearly 13% jump in the fourth quarter, while Sodexo North America overall fell 1%. The sports and entertainment, convention and airport unit renewed the Mariners, returned to the Florida Panthers' arena and added college accounts, and benefited from seven World Cup matches at Hard Rock Stadium. Parent Sodexo's overall revenue dipped slightly.
items.what_it_means: Spending at live events kept growing in 2026 even as the wider contract-catering business softened.

items.title: Highmark Stadium family gameday costs questioned at panel
items.summary: Consumer advocates told a New York Assembly hearing that Buffalo's Highmark Stadium is the most expensive in the NFL for a family of four, at more than $2,190 a game, citing an Action Network analysis. That is more than $700 above the league average, according to the Buffalo News. The committee is examining concession prices at venues and the idea of street pricing, where food and drink cost the same inside as outside.
items.what_it_means: The total cost of a family day out is drawing political scrutiny, which raises the stakes on the value fans feel they get.
